paper_metadata.title: Structures and properties of bulk glass forming Ni Nb Sn alloys and Ni Nb Ta Sn alloys

evidence.quote: Ternary Ni60Nb40−xSnx (3 ≤ x < 9 at.%) ... Ni-base alloys were found to form bulk amorphous structures using conventional metallic-mold casting.
quaternary Ni60(Nb100−xTax)34Sn6 (x = 20, 40, 60 and 80 at.%) Ni-base alloys were found to form bulk amorphous structures using conventional metallic-mold casting.

The ternary (and quaternary) alloy ingots were prepared by arc melting a mixture of ultrasonically-cleaned elements with a purity of 99.7 at.% or better in a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere.

the discrepancy between the measured strength and the theoretically calculated strength, or, in other words, the premature fracture behavior, of these refractory Ni-base BMGs may be interpreted as a result of the phase separation.

The phase separation may be responsible for the strong composition dependence of the measured strength and the obvious discrepancy between the measured and the theoretical strengths (i.e. the premature fracture behavior).
